title: What if you were trapped in a supermarket for 30 days during a zombie apocalypse?
formula: Hook -> time markers -> snap -> Luckily/Unluckily -> real-world turn -> callback loop
facts: A closed, full freezer holds food frozen for about 48 hours without power (USDA food safety guidance; verify wording before voice).
Battery-powered toys work without mains power (real-world logic, no source needed).
Zombies hunting by sound: genre convention, played straight as the world's rule.

lines.narration: You're locked inside a supermarket for 30 days. Outside, zombies, inside, you and 11 rotisserie *chickens*!
lines.scene: Cold open: you on top of a checkout belt hugging a rotisserie chicken; zombie silhouettes press on the glass doors behind.
lines.spoken: You're locked inside a supermarket for thirty days. Outside, zombies, inside, you and eleven rotisserie chickens!

lines.narration: Day 1, you barricade the doors with shopping carts, a pallet of water, and a cardboard man who really loves *yogurt*.
lines.scene: You wedge carts and a water pallet against the doors; last, a grinning life-size cardboard yogurt cutout.
lines.gag: Cutout's grin is huge and unsettling
lines.spoken: Day one, you barricade the doors with shopping carts, a pallet of water, and a cardboard man who REALLY loves yogurt.

lines.narration: He's your only friend now. You name him *Greg*.
lines.scene: You pat the cutout on the shoulder. Name tag 'GREG' slaps onto him.
lines.gag: Name tag pops on with a thump
lines.spoken: He's your only friend now. [deadpan] You name him Greg.

lines.narration: Day 3, the power's still on, so you live like royalty: sushi for breakfast, cake for lunch, a whole chicken, eaten *standing up*!
lines.scene: Three quick inserts: sushi tray, whole cake, you upright gnawing a chicken in the deli light, paper crown from the party aisle.
lines.camera: Hard cuts on each food, final arc around you
lines.spoken: Day three, the power's still on, so you live like royalty: sushi for breakfast, cake for lunch, a whole chicken, eaten standing up!

lines.scene: Aisle lights shut off row by row toward camera; you stop chewing.
lines.camera: Fast pull-out down the main aisle
lines.gag: Lights die in sequence, last one over your head
lines.spoken: Day seven... the power goes out.

lines.narration: A closed freezer stays frozen for about two days, and the clock just *started*.
lines.scene: Freezer wall, frost dripping; a giant cartoon stopwatch card appears above it and starts ticking.

lines.narration: Day 10, the seafood counter develops a *personality*.
lines.scene: Night interior, blue window light. A thawed fish on ice slowly turns to look at you. Green stink lines.
lines.spoken: Day ten, the seafood counter develops a personality.

lines.narration: Day 14, you build a fort out of 400 rolls of toilet paper. It's perfect. Greg does not *approve*.
lines.scene: Toilet-paper castle with turrets; Greg 'standing guard' at the gate, same grin.
lines.camera: Crane up to reveal the fort
lines.spoken: Day fourteen, you build a fort out of four hundred rolls of toilet paper. It's perfect. [deadpan] Greg does NOT approve.

lines.narration: Day 25, you open your final bag of chips... and outside, every zombie goes completely *silent*.
lines.scene: Inside the fort you crinkle open chips. Cut outside: every zombie head snaps toward the store at once.
lines.camera: Hard cut to wide exterior, then slow push
lines.spoken: Day twenty-five, you open your final bag of chips... and outside, every zombie goes completely silent.

lines.scene: Extreme close-up: you mid-crunch, eyes sliding sideways.

lines.narration: The front glass explodes, your fort collapses, and Greg goes *down*!
lines.scene: Glass bursts (white flash), TP fort topples like dominoes, Greg falls flat on his face.
lines.camera: Impact kick, whip pan to Greg

lines.narration: You see, zombies hunt by *sound*, and nothing in this building is louder than your *chewing*.
lines.scene: POV over your shoulder: the horde shuffling between aisles; you frozen with a chip in your mouth.
lines.gag: Giant 'CRUNCH' sound-wave card from your mouth

lines.narration: Luckily, the loudest thing in the store is in aisle *9*.
lines.scene: Map-style top-down of the store; aisle 9 glows.
lines.gag: Aisle 9 has a heavenly spotlight and a choir card
lines.spoken: Luckily, the loudest thing in the store is in aisle nine.

lines.scene: Same top-down: a solid wall of zombie dots between you and aisle 9.

lines.narration: Aisle 9 is toys, and every toy runs on *batteries*!
lines.scene: Shelves of toys in the dark, their little lights blinking.
lines.gag: Every toy is staring at you
lines.spoken: Aisle nine is toys, and every toy runs on batteries!

lines.narration: So you sprint the aisle smacking every button: 200 singing plastic fish, 40 talking dolls, and one very confident toy *drum*!
lines.scene: You run, slapping boxes; fish sing, dolls talk, a drum rolls itself into the aisle.
lines.gag: Drum keeps playing on its own
lines.spoken: So you sprint the aisle smacking every button: two hundred singing plastic fish, forty talking dolls, and one very confident toy drum!

lines.narration: Every zombie turns toward the noise, and you tiptoe out the front door with Greg under your *arm*.
lines.scene: The horde shambles into aisle 9; you sneak out the broken doors carrying Greg like a surfboard.

lines.narration: Day 30, rescue finally arrives, and they ask if you're ready to *leave*.
lines.scene: Golden dawn, army truck, a soldier offers a hand. You and Greg at the curb.
lines.gag: Greg is wearing a tiny paper crown now
lines.spoken: Day thirty, rescue finally arrives, and they ask if you're ready to leave.

lines.narration: You look at Greg. You ask for 30 more *days*.
lines.scene: You glance at Greg; Greg grins. You turn back to the soldier, dead serious.
lines.camera: Push-in on your face, end on the word
lines.spoken: You look at Greg. [pause] You ask for thirty more days.
